block.prompt: Before you write your essay, complete this brief planning grid. It will help you organise your ideas and ensure your essay is balanced and well-structured.
block.answer_key: The five rows correspond to the essay structure: 1. Introduction (hook + thesis statement) 2. Body paragraph 1: AI as opportunity (topic sentence + 2 supporting points + example) 3. Body paragraph 2: AI as threat (topic sentence + 2 supporting points + example) 4. Body paragraph 3: own evaluated position / synthesis 5. Conclusion (summary + broader implication). Accept any coherent plan — the purpose is to scaffold the writing process, not to pre-assess content.
watch_outs: Schüler:innen überspringen die Planungsphase gern und schreiben sofort drauflos — das Zeitlimit für diesen Schritt (7 Min.) deutlich kommunizieren.
Häufig fehlt ein expliziter Standpunkt im Plan. Darauf hinweisen, dass die eigene Position im Essay klar erkennbar sein muss.
